views.def:
SELECT d.id AS dept_id,
    d.dept_name,
    i.id AS item_id,
    i.item_code,
    i.item_name,
    i.category,
    i.use_unit,
    COALESCE(sc.qty, 0) AS current_qty,
    dis.safety_stock,
    dis.reorder_qty,
    COALESCE(sc.qty, 0) - dis.safety_stock AS shortage,
    dis.id AS setting_id
   FROM mso_manage.dept_item_settings dis
     JOIN mso_manage.departments d ON d.id = dis.dept_id
     JOIN mso_manage.items i ON i.id = dis.item_id
     LEFT JOIN mso_manage.stock_current sc ON sc.item_id = dis.item_id AND sc.dept_id = dis.dept_id
  WHERE dis.active = 'Y'::text;
views.name: mso_manage.dept_stock_alert

views.def:
SELECT id,
    user_name,
    phone,
    role,
    clinic_code,
    clinic_name,
    team_code,
    team_name,
    team_group_code,
    department,
    active,
    page_perms,
    created_at,
    updated_at,
    allowed_pages,
    favorites,
    email,
    position_code,
    position_name,
    is_admin,
    is_signage_manager,
    is_equipment_manager,
    is_qc_manager,
    equipment_role
   FROM mso_manage.user_profiles up
  WHERE mso_manage.current_user_is_admin() OR mso_manage.has_level('master/org'::text, 'manager'::text);
